deltas.new: A living northern coalition of overgrown poros, bow hunters, trolls, Frostguard Draklorn, winter seers, druvask outriders and great Harbinger birds. Finite arrows and adapted ritual attacks support grounded northern warriors; upgraded Flufts cross obstacles by rolling leaps, while Rimewake Harbingers add a limited physical ritual-call shot. This inhabited timber-and-snow village and its regional skirmish roster are project adaptations: rival tribes, Frostguard institutions and faiths do not canonically share one allegiance.
deltas.old: A living northern survival army of fragile omen-hawk flyers, bow hunters, trolls, altered Ursine, short-range spirit shamans, druvask outriders and heavy yetis. Four base melee-walking lines, one flyer and two shooters become three melee walkers, one flyer and three shooters when Ancient Yeti gains a limited physical ice-boulder attack. This Avarosan-oriented settlement and regional skirmish coalition are project adaptations; rival tribes and faiths are not one canonical loyal government.
deltas.reason: Retired Hawk/Ursine/Shaman/Yeti ladder does not describe the current seven replacement lines.

deltas.new: Town defenders receive a 10% Water-school spell-damage protection floor using the strongest-only Freljord Water ward group; stronger native Water protection still works. Does not block control, friendly support or resurrect casualties. Harbingers have no innate Water ward from their creature line.
deltas.old: Town defenders receive a 10% Water-school spell-damage protection floor using the strongest-only Freljord Water ward group; stronger native Water protection still works. Does not block control, friendly support or resurrect casualties. Yetis have no inherited Wyrm ward.
